notes:
Anivora 0.1.23 adds resumable episode parts, playback during downloads and catalogue resilience.

- Home survives AniList 403 with clearer errors and cached catalogue when available. One delayed automatic retry respects short Retry-After windows; manual refresh remains available. Search and Schedule share the friendly catalogue errors.
- Episode downloads use a named work folder, show overall progress and “Downloading part N/M”, then “Merging files…”.
- Fully written parts survive pause, process death and retry. Expired tokens are refreshed only when the same episode/rendition can be retained safely.
- Play available episode parts from Downloads. Playback buffers at the download frontier and continues as the next parts finish.
- Both modes finish as a verified MP4: private offline storage for In-App; default Downloads or your selected SAF folder for External. Recoverable parts remain after merge/export failures. Active readers retain their parts until they switch to the final MP4 or close; then the work folder is removed.
- MP4-only sources offer Retry as External. Downloads adds All, Anime, Manga, Active and Failed filters and clearer provider/network/merge errors.
- Manga stays chapter/page based. The working WeebCentral resolver, five-slot native queue, notifications, history/My List separation and independent updater are preserved.

In-App still requires a finite, supported HLS source. Progressive MP4 playback can start early when the server supports validated byte ranges and the file has leading playback metadata; other MP4 files become playable on completion. English WebVTT is saved when available and selected.

Package: `com.brandon300.anivora`. Version: `0.1.23` / Android code `25`. Existing signing certificate retained. ARM64 Android APK targets the Infinix Hot 50i architecture; physical-device installation is not claimed by emulator checks.

README updated for the current app, build process and download behavior. A first launch on a blocked network without saved catalogue data still requires a working connection; it shows friendly guidance and retry.
